g.text: | OI-8 | EPS-fault siren latency ≤ 1.26 s worst case from fault onset (T-28; corrected 2026-10-13 from ≈ 1.14 s: the

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #14263d

g.text: speaker sounds only on every other 8 Hz tick) exceeds the SG-02 1 s warning budget (§3.7). TSR-516's ≤ 0.5 s after

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #14263d

g.text: detection is met (≤ 0.26 s) only because WP-S-02 v0.14 defines detection as the 1 s persistence; measured from the

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #14263d

g.text: first fault frame it is not. Caused by the maintainer decision of 2026-10-12 (persistent faults only, 1 s; EPS-fault

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #14263d

g.text: impact record §7). Options: shorten the persistence (e.g. 0.7 s), or justify that LKA actuation is already refused

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #14263d

g.text: from the first fault frame (lateral authority removed at onset; the warning is for a lasting loss). **Decision

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #14263d

g.text: needed.** No requirement changed here (added 2026-10-12) | Safety manager | G2 |

g.text: Propose remedy options; do not redefine the budget to hide the discrepancy.
